question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (3)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**more**" is often used in comparisons to indicate a greater degree. In this context, it implies increasing generating capacity to a greater extent. (अधिक)
 
• The other options: "**enough**," "**most**," and "**so**" do not fit the context of describing the extent to which generating capacity was to be increased.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The initial two Russian PWR types at the Kudankulam site were apart from India's three-stage plan for nuclear power and were simply to increase generating capacity more__ rapidly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Enough (पर्याप्त)**: Indicates a sufficient amount, which does not fit the context of increasing capacity to a greater degree.
 
• **Most (अधिकांश)**: Indicates the greatest amount, but does not fit the context of increasing or the comparison being made.
 
• **So (इतना)**: Usually used as an adverb to describe the degree of something, but does not fit the required comparative context here.
